publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Scientific algorithmic teaching reconstruction, not a photograph, micrograph, scan, assay result, diagnostic image, treatment result, or procedural instruction
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: Controlled scientific records supplied identity and conservative representation boundaries only; no source image or design was copied. Related identifiers are explicitly distinguished from exact concept identities.

reviewStandard: Each of the six frozen routes received exactly one built-in generation call. All six originals were preserved and inspected independently at native 1536 by 1024 resolution. Literal output, exact body and group counts, connectivity, prohibited content, outer 32-pixel field, crop bounds, hashes, and conservative meaning controlled disposition; prompt intent was never treated as observation. Both independent reviewers agreed on all route dispositions, and crop disagreement was resolved conservatively.
promotionRule: Only the exact accepted fenton-chemistry and functional-shielding source hashes were promoted to metadata-bearing lossless masters, article WebPs, and centered contain-mode 1200 by 630 social WebPs. The fermentative-metabolism, ferroptosis, GABA, and gene-regulation originals remain immutable non-public quarantines.

assets.scientificFinding: Fenton chemistry is condition-sensitive and may involve different oxidants and mechanisms; separate iron-, peroxide-, and hydroxyl-context teaching units do not establish oxidation state, stoichiometry, reaction order, intermediate identity, kinetics, or biological outcome.
assets.visualReview: Three triangular groups contain two separate iron-context spheres, two identical four-component peroxide-context units, and two identical two-component hydroxyl-context units—six primary units and fourteen visible component bodies in total.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower dual independent native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Three unconnected groups contain exactly two related gray spheres, two identical units each composed of two connected larger pale lobes plus two attached terminal beads, and two identical units each composed of one larger pale body plus one attached bead.

assets.proposedAlt: Two gray spheres sit apart from paired peroxide-context units and paired hydroxyl-context units in three unconnected groups.
assets.proposedCaption: Separate iron-, peroxide-, and hydroxyl-context teaching models orient Fenton chemistry. Their counts and arrangement do not show oxidation states, stoichiometry, a reaction sequence, an intermediate, kinetics, biological damage, or treatment.
assets.proposedDescription: WikiBiome scientific reconstruction of separate component-context teaching models for Fenton chemistry on a pale cool field.
assets.proposedProvenance: Generated once from the immutable Batch 070 prompt after canonical-concept, IUPAC, current mechanistic-literature, and condition-sensitive representation review; independently audited at native resolution. Review-only trained-algorithmic reconstruction.

assets.visualReview: The plate contains the requested nine primary bodies and three groups, but the three substrate-context pieces differ visibly in silhouette and apparent lobe organization.
assets.quarantineReason: The frozen prompt required three identical substrate-context pieces. The nonidentical models prevent a faithful literal caption and fail the exact composition gate.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower dual independent native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Three groups contain one straight rod, one coccoid, one curved rod, three visibly nonidentical pale multi-lobed pieces, one single product-context body, one paired-lobe body, and one three-lobed body.

assets.visualReview: The eight primary-unit count and neutral intact models are present, but the membrane has three visible headgroup rows and the groups form a top-to-bottom stack.
assets.quarantineReason: The membrane contradicts the exact two-row control, while the vertical cell-to-membrane-to-token layout conflicts with the triangular equal-status, no-sequence boundary.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower dual independent native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: A vertical stack contains one intact cell with one nucleus, one intact membrane strip with two staggered upper headgroup rows and one lower row, three separate iron-context spheres, and three fused two-lobe-plus-bead tokens.
outputAudit.quarantineReason: The plate renders three membrane headgroup rows and a potentially sequential vertical grouping rather than the frozen two-row triangular composition.

assets.scientificFinding: Functional shielding is a WikiBiome literature-derived construct rather than a controlled MeSH concept; related matrix, fungal, and bacterial contexts do not establish a mixed biofilm, physical shielding, resistance, immune evasion, persistence, or universal mechanism.
assets.visualReview: Three triangular groups contain one complete porous matrix-context slab, three separate smooth nonbudding ovoids, and five separate rounded rods—nine primary bodies in total without contact or enclosure.
